As Eaton Plc (ETN) Share Value Declined, Holder Alps Advisors Lowered by $2.19 Million Its Holding; Apple (AAPL) Shareholder Eagleclaw Capital Managment Has Lowered Its Stake
June 10, 2018 - By Adrian Mccoy
Alps Advisors Inc decreased its stake in Eaton Corp Plc (ETN) by 4.4% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Alps Advisors Inc sold 27,754 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.87% with the market. The institutional investor held 603,138 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $48.20M, down from 630,892 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Alps Advisors Inc who had been investing in Eaton Corp Plc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $35.14B market cap company. The stock increased 0.01% or $0.01 during the last trading session, reaching $80.35. About 1.68M shares traded. Eaton Corporation plc (NYSE:ETN) has risen 1.24% since June 10, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 11.33% the S&P500.
